profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Current work includes integrating existing machine learning algorithms into Splunk applications and other frameworks. Technologies include Python, Ansible, Docker, Kubernetes and Splunk.

Previous Experience:

Lead developer maintaining and enhancing a Java Spring application used in the shipping industry that aggregates and shares data via Camel, REST, FTP, and SOAP interfaces.

Developer on big data security platform used in industrial environments that aggregated enterprise data for easy query, analysis and visualization. Using machine learning, the platform established baselines seen in the data and then detected anomalous behavior. My responsibilities included developing Java REST APIs, HBase and Elasticsearch queries, Angular UI components, and Apache Nifi flows. In addition, I setup continuous integration by maven-izing code bases, organizing and creating Git repositories, setting up build jobs in Jenkins, as well as Artifactory integration. I automated a majority of our product deployment using Ansible scripts and also rearchitected our documentation tooling and delivery using the AsciiDoc markup language.

Diverse range of projects from enterprise security to SEO advertising management to defense projects involving mission planning and data aggregation.
